hook.name: RetardV111DelayedHookProxy
hook.description: A time-delayed upgradeable proxy for a Uniswap v4 hook using EIP-1967 storage slots and delegatecall. The proxied implementation handles beforeSwap (with delta return), beforeAddLiquidity, and beforeInitialize. Upgrades require a minimum 1-day delay, must be scheduled then executed by an authority address, and are validated for storage-version and config compatibility.
